messages:
alex: Quick thought — proposing span name pattern `llm.request.{phase}` where phase ∈ {receive, route, infer, emit}. Keeps span trees readable and filters simple. Thoughts?
sasha: +1 to phase breakdown. But worried about explosion in dashboards — prefer `llm.request` with `llm.phase` attr.
maria: We need semantic attrs for model: `model.name`, `model.version`, `model.variant`. Also tokens: `tokens.prompt`, `tokens.generated`, `tokens.total`. And `kvcache.hits` and `kvcache.prefix_cached` boolean.
josh: For routing, include `route.policy` (latency|cost|locality), `route.fallback` boolean, and `customer.tier` — helps cost analytics.
devex-bot: Noted: analytics pipeline prefers flat keys; OTLP exporters will accept dots but our downstream BigQuery mapping prefers underscores.
li: Concerning retention: keep detailed spans (with token counts) 30d, aggregated metrics 365d. Sampling per-model+route: 1% default, 100% for canaries.
sasha: Agree on sampling by route+model. Also record `prompt.hash` for quality signals but hashed client-side to avoid PII; store as `prompt.id`.
alex: One more — span status values: use `ok`, `degraded`, `fallback`, `error` and set `span.status_message` optional. This helps SLO dashboards.
maria: nit: prefer `llm.kv_cache.hit_count` to avoid collision with other caches.
alex: ok, I'll spin up a short RFC + tracing test harness. Can people add examples of current span usages in the thread? @sasha @maria
sasha: I'll paste a snippet in the RFC.
otel-bot: Created RFC issue #459: /rfc/459-span-vocab-llm. Assigned to alex.
